Row.Text: The shawm cries out and England casts off into the wild main. Charters in hand, the intrepid fill cargo holds with luxuries and maps with opportunities. At home, the minds of the people soar as scientific empiricism vies with the theater’s imagination. Grasp the ship’s wheel or the playwright’s pen, and set England’s course.
An island is a landmass with 30 or fewer connected land tiles. The tile tooltip will tell you if something is an island or not, so watch for that when planning Settlements as England.
